intro: The in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) only appears after the story — but every item below can be worked on from Chapter 2 onward, and work done earlier counts. Tick an item here when the game says it is done. The counts are the ones PlayStation tracks; where the game itself is the only source for a number, the card says so.

items.detail: Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Use aircraft for the flying stunts and loop one repeatable stunt for the last stretch.
items.title: Stunts

items.detail: Listed under Progress, then Challenges. Clear everything above 50% first, then the cheapest remaining ones.
items.title: Challenges

items.detail: Scan traffic with the WAiNK app. Variety matters more than repeats — a model already scanned does not count twice.
items.title: Vehicles discovered

items.detail: Unlocked through That's Where The Money Is (optional, near the end of Chapter 4). Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone.
items.title: Bank vaults robbed

items.detail: One operation from each of the nine gangs is enough for Pest Control; all 39 are needed here. Take every valuable at each operation before leaving.
items.title: Illegal operations robbed

items.detail: Two shooting ranges, 42 golds between them. Clear one weapon's full set before switching weapons.
items.title: Shooting Range gold medals

items.detail: A win at every one of the 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations. Fly a practice run first to learn the gates.
items.title: Drone race wins

items.detail: Any 20 distinct races count. Drone-race wins count here and toward Top Fun, so do the drone locations first.
items.title: Race wins

items.detail: Marked bills come from bank and payday-loan jobs. Launder after every job — a stockpile counts for nothing.
items.title: Marked bills laundered

items.detail: Three sets pay Don't Touch My Deck; the 100% checklist wants more than three. Finish one set completely before starting the next.
items.title: Collectible Card sets
items.unit: sets (at least 4; the game tracks the exact count)

items.detail: Tag as you travel — every new district is a chance to tick a few more off. Sweep the Keys and inland towns last.
items.title: WAiNK locations tagged

items.detail: Spots show as purple icons when you are close. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation is missable — do it before Chapter 1 ends. Each outdoor spot counts twice with both characters.
items.title: Meditation spots

items.detail: Eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app (after Daily Driver, Chapter 2). About $160,000 together; story-given garages do not count.
items.title: Garage properties purchased

items.detail: Register through the Scooter Bros app (after Moses, Chapter 2) or at Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3. Each car needs a free garage space.
items.title: Vehicles registered

items.detail: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do not count (they have their own trophies). The Chapter 3 Yago race is time-sensitive.
items.title: Stranger mission strands

items.detail: Robberies and fights feed the profile. It fills up on its own if you play aggressively through the rest of the list.
items.title: Criminal Profile actions

title: 100% Completion checklist
